messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered — billing/metering-prod: token-count variance above threshold for multiple accounts. Incident ID: INC-2026-0421. Auto-triage: severity=P2, possible customer overage flags.

alex (oncall): I'm on it. Loading the dashboard now — looks like a spike starting 02:17 UTC, sustained for ~23m. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/billing/metering-prod?range=30m :eyes: 

sam (sre): seeing increased consumer lag on kafka-topic=usage-evts (consumer group metering-forwarder). current lag: ~1.2M messages. Retention ok. Any recent deploys to metering services?

jordan (eng): deploy-bot shows a rollout to metering-batcher v3.4.1 at 01:58 UTC, config change: dedupe window changed from 60s -> 300s. I didn't expect that to blow up counts but maybe replay + longer window caused double-emission.

maria (billing): heads-up: downstream alerting flagged automatic overage emails queued for 6 accounts (acct_45, acct_99, acct_210, others). We haven't sent final invoices but the overage flagging subsystem is preparing notifications. Need to stop false positives asap.

alex (oncall): action plan proposal: 1) pause metering-forwarder consumer to stop forwarding counts to billing, 2) enable billing-safety-mode (cap reports) as fallback, 3) start live reconciliation job to diff current emitted counts vs upstream raw tokens, 4) notify CS for affected customers. Thoughts?

sam (sre): agree. pausing consumer now. Command: 
```
# temporarily pause metering-forwarder by scaling to 0
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/metering-forwarder --replicas=0
# verify consumer group liveness
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group metering-forwarder
```

ops-bot: Action executed: scaled deployment metering-forwarder -> 0 replicas.

alex (oncall): billing-safety-mode is a feature-flag we can flip to cap account daily delta at 110% of rolling 7d median. Flipping to true now.

jordan (eng): flipping flag via feature service. curl command: 
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.ai/api/flags/billing-safety-mode -d '{"value":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

ops-bot: Feature flag updated: billing-safety-mode=true (propagating).

lee (customer-success): I'll draft a short message for the affected customers — we should say we're pausing automated overage notifications and will follow up with reconciled usage. Please add account list and ETA.

maria (billing): starting a quick reconciliation query against raw_ingest.tokens (window 02:00-02:30). SQL snippet I'm running: 
```
SELECT acct_id, SUM(tokens) AS raw_tokens
FROM raw_ingest.tokens
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-04-21T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-21T02:30:00Z'
GROUP BY acct_id
ORDER BY raw_tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

sam (sre): also running a replay-sanity check to detect duplicates emitted by batcher. simple python check to compare message IDs seen vs emitted: 
```
# pseudocode
seen = set()
dups = []
for m in consumer_read("usage-evts", from_offset=start):
    if m.id in seen: dups.append(m.id)
    else: seen.add(m.id)
print(len(dups))
```

alex (oncall): initial customer impact: 6 accounts flagged for overage, probable over-counting for an additional ~20 accounts under investigation. No charges applied yet because we hold billing pipeline until reconciliation completes. Maria, confirm hold is in effect?

maria (billing): confirmed — invoice emission job is paused for the current window, and billing engine has not created final charge events. We'll keep it paused until reconciliation finishes or until 06:00 UTC.

jordan (eng): found likely root cause: batcher v3.4.1 writes a checkpoint after emit but a race condition in commit-on-success leads to duplicate emits during transient errors. When consumer was lagging, replay + longer dedupe window combined to surface duplicates. Creating a hotfix branch now.

sam (sre): mitigation checklist: 
- paused forwarder (done)
- enabled safety flag (done)
- paused invoice emission (done)
- collecting offsets and message samples for replay analysis (in progress)

alex (oncall): customer comms draft (lee): "We're investigating a metering anomaly that may have caused inflated usage indicators. We have temporarily paused automated overage emails and will provide reconciled usage within 4 hours. No invoices will be sent until we confirm counts." Lee please ping once ready. :email:

lee (customer-success): message ready, sending to the 6 accounts now as a temporary hold notification. cc @maria.

maria (billing): reconciliation result (first pass): acct_45: raw_tokens=12,234 vs emitted=36,701 (3x), acct_99: raw=8,001 vs emitted=7,980 (ok), acct_210: raw=54,000 vs emitted=162,000 (3x) — pattern suggests 3x duplication on some partitions. Exporting full CSV and attaching to INC ticket.

jordan (eng): pushing quick fix to set commit semantics back to immediate-ack (rollback of the dedupe-window change) and adding an extra idempotency key to emitted records. Deploying to canary (1 pod) now.

ops-bot: Deployment metering-batcher v3.4.2-canary started (1/1 pods healthy).

sam (sre): monitoring canary. If good for 5m we'll promote. Watchpoints: emitted rate, duplicate-id count, kafka lag.

alex (oncall): for bookkeeping — creating followups: INC-2026-0421-1 (root cause analysis), TASK-9872 (backfill/reconcile), TASK-9873 (billing automation add guardrails), COMM-231 (customer follow-up). Assigning to jordan/sam/maria.

lee (customer-success): customers acknowledged the temporary notification; 2 asked for an estimate on invoice impact. I'll update once we have reconciliation summary.

jordan (eng): canary looks clean for 7m, duplicate-id count dropped to 0 on canary partition sample. Promoting to full deploy. Command: 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/metering-batcher
```

ops-bot: Rollout initiated for metering-batcher; 5 replicas restarting.

sam (sre): after rollout, replay samples show duplicates down to <1% and emitted rate back to expected. Kafka lag is decreasing (now 120k).

maria (billing): recon job final pass complete: accounts previously in overage flagged set are reconciled, the inflated counts were not persisted to billing events thanks to the pause. Preparing official incident summary and recommended credit/adjustments for affected accounts.

alex (oncall): postmortem notes to capture: timeline, change to dedupe window, commit race, how consumer lag magnified issue, the playbook steps we used, and follow-ups. Target RCA publish by EOD.

lee (customer-success): I'll coordinate the customer outreach for tomorrow morning with the reconciled numbers and proposed credits.

maria (billing): marking incident as mitigated at 03:46 UTC. Will not close until RCA & billing adjustments complete.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status updated: mitigated. Notes: safety flag enabled, forwarder paused then redeployed with fix, invoice emission paused, reconciliation completed for impacted accounts.

alex (oncall): thanks team. action items assigned. I'll follow up on RCA doc and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:

jordan (eng): RCA draft in progress: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0421/rca.md — will add commit diff and test coverage.

sam (sre): leaving a note to add an automated alarm for duplicate-id rate > 0.5% over 5m and a runbook step to auto-enable billing-safety-mode if that alarm fires.

maria (billing): capturing billing adjustments in TASK-9872 and notifying finance.

lee (customer-success): closing the communication loop with customers — follow-up scheduled for 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

alex (oncall): closing thread for live triage. If anything resurfaces ping page.

(+:maria reacted with :white_check_mark: )
